jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Why GM Financial? GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses. At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive. Our Purpose: We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters. This position will be posted until filled. NOTE: We are unable to consider candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position. About The Role This role focuses on designing, integrating, and managing data pipelines that collect, transform, and monitor data from internal and external sources to support business and analytics needs. The position collaborates with business stakeholders, data engineering teams, and privacy compliance partners to implement scalable data solutions, improve data processes, and evaluate emerging technologies that drive innovation and operational efficiency. Responsibilities In this role you will: ﻿Work with internal business partners to identify, capture, collect, and format data from the external sources, internal systems and the data warehouse to extract features of interest Contribute to the evaluation, research, experimentation efforts with batch and streaming data engineering technologies in a lab to keep pace with industry innovation Work with data engineering related groups to inform on and showcase capabilities of emerging technologies and to enable the adoption of these new technologies and associated techniques Coordinate with Privacy Compliance to ensure proper data collection and handling Create and implement business rules and functional enhancements for data schemas and processes Coordinate with Privacy Compliance to ensure proper data collection and handling Perform data load monitoring and resolution Work with internal business clients to problem solve data availability and activation issues Qualifications What makes You an ideal candidate? You're a strong fit if you enjoy solving complex data challenges, working with modern cloud technologies, and building scalable solutions that turn data into meaningful insights. You're comfortable collaborating across teams, learning new technologies, and using AI- enabled tools to work more efficiently. Knowledge And Skills Experience designing, processing, and managing large-scale data using technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, HDFS, or similar distributed platforms. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, ARM Templates, or CloudFormation. Experience building and maintaining ETL/data pipelines and working with multiple data formats and sources, including JSON, Parquet, relational databases, cloud databases, and messaging platforms. Understanding of modern data architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, streaming pipelines, and object storage technologies such as ADLS Gen2 and Amazon S3. Experience with SQL and NoSQL technologies such as Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis, with the ability to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with DevOps and software development practices, including Git, CI/CD, build tools, code quality tools, and artifact management. Experience with digital data and customer-data technologies such as Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, Journey Analytics, tag management platforms, SDKs, and REST APIs. Understanding of data privacy, security, governance, and regulatory considerations, including GDPR. Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum, SAFe, or similar methodologies. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and data insights clearly. Additional Knowledge And Skills Working effectively within an AI enabled environment: Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection Work Experience & Education Experience with data engineering preferred High School Diploma or equivalent required Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent experience required What We Offer: Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays. Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive. Compensation: Competitive pay and bonus eligibility. Work Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work environment, 2-days a week in office. NOTE: We are unable to consider candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position. This position is not open to agency submissions #GMFJobs

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Junior
jobs.description: Role Overview: A Junior Data Engineer supporting the development of cloud-native data products and pipelines to enable enterprise analytics and AI capabilities. Key Responsibilities Write, review, and contribute to code within a collaborative engineering team to build robust technical solutions. Design and deploy high-performance, cloud-based data components for enterprise use. Build and maintain reusable data platform features, ingestion frameworks, and data products (using tools like dbt, Azure Logic Apps, and Snowflake). Support reliable data pipeline operations, including monitoring, testing, and recovery. Maintain synchronization between source systems and cloud platforms. Develop scalable data transformation pipelines to facilitate analytics and AI-driven insights. Implement data engineering best practices, such as CI/CD, testing, and code reviews. Contribute ideas to the team's data engineering roadmap as skills develop. Qualifications & Skills Proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms. Knowledge of ELT processes, data modeling, and transformation frameworks like dbt. Familiarity with data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks. Exposure to data processing technologies like Apache Spark or streaming systems is advantageous. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or GitHub Actions. Experience designing or supporting large-scale data pipelines, with a strong desire to grow expertise in data architecture, observability, and best practices. Effective communication skills for working with technical teams and business stakeholders. Educational background in Computer Science or related experience. Preferred Qualifications Interest or experience with GenAI, LLMs, vector search, or agentic workflows. Background in food service, hospitality, retail, or consumer industries.

jobs.title: Consultant, Data Engineer
jobs.description: This is a hybrid role and requires work on-site with our clients About Infinitive: Infinitive is a data and AI consultancy that enables its clients to modernize, monetize and operationalize their data to create lasting and substantial value. We possess deep industry and technology expertise to drive and sustain adoption of new capabilities. We match our people and personalities to our clients' culture while bringing the right mix of talent and skills to enable high return on investment. Infinitive has been named “Best Small Firms to Work For” by Consulting Magazine 9 times most recently in 2026. Infinitive has also been named a Washington Post “Top Workplace”, Washington Business Journal “Best Places to Work”, and Virginia Business “Best Places to Work.” About The Role As a Consultant, Data Engineer, you will build and maintain data pipelines on Databricks for Infinitive clients. You will work on project teams with senior engineers, architects and business analysts, writing production Python, PySpark and SQL code that moves data from source systems into tables the client's analysts and data scientists use every day. The role is ideal for an engineer with one to three years of experience who wants client-facing work and regular exposure to new data platforms and industries. The client location is McLean, Virginia. What You Will Do Build and maintain batch and incremental ETL pipelines in Databricks using Python, PySpark and Spark SQL Ingest data from relational databases, APIs, flat files and cloud storage (Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage) into Delta Lake tables Implement bronze, silver and gold layers following medallion architecture patterns Write and tune SQL for transformations, data validation and reporting tables Add data quality checks, handle schema changes and troubleshoot failed jobs Schedule and monitor workloads with Databricks Workflows, working within Unity Catalog permissions Tune Spark jobs for performance and cost, including partitioning, file sizing and cluster configuration Use Git for version control, take part in code reviews and contribute to CI/CD pipelines Document pipelines, source-to-target mappings and runbooks so client teams can run what you build Join client meetings to clarify requirements, report status and walk through your work What You Bring 1 to 3 years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience Hands-on experience with Databricks on a professional or substantial academic project Working proficiency in Python for data processing Experience building transformations with Apache Spark and PySpark (DataFrames and Spark SQL) Strong SQL, including joins, window functions, CTEs and aggregations Understanding of ETL concepts such as incremental loads, slowly changing dimensions, dimensional modeling and data quality checks Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort explaining technical work to non-technical stakeholders Authorization to work in the United States [confirm sponsorship policy] Nice to have Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification Experience with Delta Lake features such as MERGE and time travel, or with Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables) Exposure to Unity Catalog, dbt, Apache Airflow or Azure Data Factory Experience with Terraform or CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Prior consulting or client-facing experience Background in financial services, healthcare or media data Infinitive is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set, level, experience, relevant training, and licensure and certifications. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $75,000 - $120,000.00. Infinitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Analyst
jobs.description: Your opportunity At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s). Schwab Technology Services enables the future of how clients manage their money by providing innovative and reliable technology products and services as part of our ongoing commitment to democratize access to investing and financial planning. As a Data & Analytics Analyst within the Bank Data & Analytics division, you will assume a pivotal responsibility in advancing Bank & Trust Services and the analytical infrastructure that supports Deposit Products, Cash Products, the Cash Platform, and Move Money experiences. Collaborating with stakeholders across business, product, operations, risk, technology, and data functions, you will facilitate the conversion of intricate business inquiries into dependable reporting and analytical frameworks that enhance organizational transparency, reinforce strategic decision-making processes, and contribute to the achievement of key business objectives. In this role, you will leverage strong analytical thinking, business process understanding, and problem-solving skills to identify opportunities for reporting enhancement, data quality improvement, workflow optimization, and operational efficiency. You will partner with stakeholders to clarify business needs, define requirements, analyze trends, and deliver insights that help inform priorities across deposits, cash features, and money movement capabilities. You will be part of a collaborative team environment where curiosity, adaptability, ownership, and continuous improvement are highly valued. By partnering closely with business leaders, product owners, data engineers, technology teams, and analytics partners, you will contribute to the delivery of reliable, scalable, and well-documented data products while growing your expertise in a highly visible and impactful area of the organization. Our Opportunity Bank Data & Analytics is focused on leveraging data to drive better business decisions and better outcomes. We are a trusted thought-partner who provides actionable insights in a consistent and timely manner. We leverage close, collaborative working relationships with business partners to apply technology solutions to a wide array of business problems and Business Intelligence needs. We are looking for a highly motivated Data & Analytics Analyst to join Bank & Trust Services and help deliver trusted data, reporting, and insights across our Deposit products, Cash Features, and Move Money capabilities. As a member of a team with broad business impact, you will partner directly with business, product, operations, risk, and technology stakeholders to analyze performance, identify trends, develop scalable reporting solutions, and translate data into actionable insights that improve client experiences, strengthen controls, and support business growth. What You’ll Do Partner with Bank & Trust Services leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs, define analytical requirements, and deliver insights that support Deposit products, Cash Features, and Move Money capabilities. Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical assets that provide visibility into client behavior, product performance, operational trends, risk indicators, and service outcomes. Use SQL and analytical tools to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from complex financial services datasets, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and business relevance. Identify trends, gaps, anomalies, and opportunities within deposit, cash, and money movement data to inform decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement efforts. Translate complex data findings into clear, concise summaries and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Support data quality, governance, and control activities by documenting logic, validating outputs, and collaborating with technology and data teams to resolve data-related issues. Help advance modern analytics practices by improving self-service reporting, documenting trusted metrics and data lineage, exploring automation opportunities, and translating insights into clear business recommendations. What you have 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role. 3+ years of experience using SQL to perform structured programming, ad hoc querying, data validation, and analysis across relational databases or cloud-based data platforms. Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, assess data quality, and connect findings to business outcomes. Ability to work directly with business partners to clarify objectives, document requirements, and deliver practical data solutions that meet business needs. Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities, multiple concurrent efforts, and tight timelines. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings, data limitations, and business implications to stakeholders at varying levels of technical depth. Experience working with financial services, banking, deposit, cash management, payments, or money movement data is a plus. Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, documentation, repeatability, and trusted reporting practices. Preferred Experience with cloud data platforms and modern analytics tools, including Google Cloud, BigQuery, Python, R, or similar technologies. Knowledge of Bank & Trust Services, deposit products, cash features, ACH, wires, checks, payments, transfers, or broader Move Money capabilities. Experience supporting product, operations, risk, control, or client experience analytics within a regulated financial services environment. Experience with modern analytics practices, including data storytelling, self-service reporting, data governance, automation or AI-enabled analysis, and delivering dashboards, datasets, or reporting assets as scalable data products. What’s in it for you At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis. We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future: 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions Paid parental leave and family building benefits Tuition reimbursement Health, dental, and vision insurance
